angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 860,581 km at 222.43 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.4958 +/- 0.0155 mas (same row, RUWE 0.83): 222.43 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.237 +/- 0.054 solar radii from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar radius of HAT-P-16 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract): 860,581 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.218 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar mass of HAT-P-16 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6158 +/- 80 K from Yalçınkaya et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-16 b's parameter set from Yalçınkaya et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.530.2475Y/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Yalçınkaya et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-16 b's parameter set from Yalçınkaya et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.530.2475Y/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-16.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.339, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-16 (pscomppars): spectral type F8, from Alexoudi 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AN....34324012A/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HAT-P-16: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-16 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.17 dex, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-16 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.29447, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-16 (pscomppars): age 0.5 Gyr, from Ciceri et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...557A..30C/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-16 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.5 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
